items.title: André Kostolany — cycle / egg psychology (shelf: 一個投機者的告白 & related)
items.summary: Public-knowledge cycle framing: firm hands accumulate near despair while shaky hands dominate near euphoria; volume marks ownership transfer; rates often lag risk appetite. Used here as an egg-phase proxy for US and TW dials, not as trade anecdotes.
items.mathGateNote: Partial: regime labels live in marketRegime; full egg→dial table still needs olympiad math gate.

items.title: Mastering the Market Cycle (掌握市場週期)
items.summary: Marks-style practice: take the market’s temperature and adjust aggressiveness rather than calling exact tops. Hot markets raise the bar; cold markets allow survivor hunting with tighter risk budgets.
formulas: temperatureScore ∈ [−2, +2] ← Σ proxies(pct_from_SMA200, dd_from_52w_high, ATR_pct_20, ΔUS10Y_20d, breadth, optional HYG/LQD)
cold (temp ≤ −1) → allow constructive/aggressive on survivors above SMA200
items.mathGateNote: temperatureScore already coded; checklist completeness + clamp proofs pending math gate.

items.title: 圖解地表最簡單的利率教科書 (rates literacy)
items.summary: Rates-literacy primer: treat yield direction as a first-class regime input. Fast spikes lean defensive; sustained declines can reopen risk-on if the egg phase is not euphoric. TW uses US10Y plus USD/TWD stress rather than pretending local yields equal US10Y.
formulas: R2: ΔUS10Y_20d ≥ +0.25 pp → dial_cap ≤ selective / defensive bias
R3: ΔUS10Y_60d ≤ −0.25 pp ∧ egg ≠ euphoric → aggressive bias allowed
items.mathGateNote: Rate features wired into regime; TW FX overlay still watch-listed for gate proofs.

items.title: 闕又上 — 勞退／退休金缺口與紀律（書架）
items.summary: TW retirement-gap framing kept only as personal drawdown / survivability hygiene. Explicitly not used as ticker alpha, pension-anecdote timing, or lifestyle leverage rules.
formulas: D3: exclude leveraged-ETF core in euphoria
items.mathGateNote: Discipline-only; FI-number and pension anecdotes excluded from screens by design.

items.title: FI / retirement shelf (夏韻芬、YMOYL、財富自由的心理學、富爸爸、錢教)
items.summary: Soft FI and money-education titles mapped to risk-discipline gates only: cash buffers, process logs, anti-FOMO in euphoria. No envelope budgets, affirmations, or Rich-Dad leverage ideology as equity factors.

items.title: Security Analysis — core concepts (Graham & Dodd)
items.summary: Original concept summary only: separate investment from speculation; anchor on earning power, asset coverage, and a margin of safety versus price. Informs value-style master packs (PE/PB/debt filters), not narrative stock tips.
formulas: value_screen ← low PE/PB ∧ tolerable debt ∧ positive operating metrics
items.mathGateNote: Public PE/PB/ROE proxies exist in master packs; full MOS math not gated yet.

items.title: The Intelligent Investor — core concepts
items.summary: Original concept summary: defensive vs enterprising investor; Mr. Market as a quote machine, not a guru; insist on process and margin of safety over forecasting. Maps to stance dials and position-size caps, not day-trade rules.
formulas: Mr_Market_quote ← last close (do not treat as intrinsic)
items.mathGateNote: Stance sizing live; enterprising checklist still conceptual.

items.title: A Random Walk Down Wall Street — core concepts
items.summary: Original concept summary: prices are hard to beat after costs; favor diversification and skepticism toward hot tips and chart superstition. Used as a caution against overfit screens and as a reminder that paper strategies need out-of-sample math gates.
formulas: require: walk-forward / regime-split checks before status=adopted
items.mathGateNote: Methodological caution; no direct buy screen from this title.

items.title: 台股結構注意事項（限漲跌／法人籌碼／T+2）— operational notes
items.summary: TW-specific operational notes derived from the bookshelf framework: ±10% limits distort RS/breadth; foreign/trust/dealer lot flows are first-class chip signals; T+2 affects cash tags only. Not a published book — kept so TW research stays visible beside US canon.
formulas: limit_aware_rs: treat near-limit clusters ≠ healthy breadth
items.mathGateNote: Several chip packs live; limit-aware breadth still candidate.

items.title: Can LLM-based Financial Investing Strategies Outperform the Market in Long Run?
items.summary: Authors propose FINSABER, a longer-horizon / wider-universe backtest for LLM timing strategies. Reported LLM edges shrink under broader cross-sections and multi-decade windows; regime splits show strategies too cautious in bulls and too aggressive in bears. Takeaway for this site: prioritise regime-aware risk controls and trend detection over stacking LLM complexity — aligns with our math-gate rule before adoption.
formulas: evaluate timing_strategy on long_window × large_universe (anti data-snooping)
regime_split: bull → avoid over-conservatism; bear → tighten risk controls
gate: require regime-aware controls before status=adopted
items.mathGateNote: Supports keeping LLM/narrative packs off production until regime-aware gates pass.

items.title: Generative AI for Stock Selection
items.summary: Studies whether generative AI can automate feature discovery in US equities via RAG and structured prompting, then feed features into tabular ML for short-horizon forecasts. AI features are competitive with baselines when retrieval quality is controlled and are weakly correlated with traditional signals (suggesting combination). Site takeaway: interesting research path, but not a drop-in screen — needs reproducible features + math gate.
formulas: watch: low corr(features_AI, classic) → optional ensemble after gate
items.mathGateNote: No production features yet; retrieval/quality controls not implemented.
